film.schemaName: L'Instant Tranquille, video tour of the holiday home
film.schemaDescription: Video tour of L'Instant Tranquille, a holiday home in Romorantin-Lanthenay, Sologne: a whole 115 m² house for six guests with three bedrooms, a fireplace, table football and an enclosed garden, plus drive times to Cheverny, Beauval zoo and Chambord. French voice-over.
